bugs_found: fx_convert mixes Decimal with float: return a * float(rate) raises TypeError for Decimal amounts, and would lose precision if coerced elsewhere
transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal; float amounts can trigger Decimal/float TypeError or precision surprises, and NaN/non-finite Decimal amounts bypass <= 0 then poison balances
compound_interest allows negative principal and silently truncates years/compounds_per_year via int(), changing inputs like 1.9 years to 1 without error
loan_payment silently truncates months via int(), so fractional month inputs are accepted with changed semantics
No function consistently rejects NaN/Infinity inputs; Decimal non-finite values can raise unexpected InvalidOperation or propagate invalid monetary results
Money results are never quantized/rounded to currency minor units, allowing sub-cent balances and fee/payment drift
